checkpoints.name: The home computer boom
checkpoints.note: Computers leave the lab and the office and arrive in the living room. The Apple II, Commodore 64 and IBM PC sell in the millions, most with BASIC built in, and a generation learns to program at home.

checkpoints.name: The browser wars
checkpoints.note: Netscape and Internet Explorer fight over the web. Microsoft gives its browser away with Windows and wins; Netscape opens its code, which becomes Mozilla and later Firefox.

checkpoints.name: The mobile shift
checkpoints.note: The phone becomes the main computer. The iPhone and Android arrive, the App Store opens, and plug-ins such as Flash begin to die because phones will not run them.
